coaching.headline: We won the late fight and opened the base after giving up Primal.
coaching.team: Four of five lanes read favored; mid was the exception.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 32.3 teamfight, won 5-0 right after the team let Primal Fangtooth go uncontested at minute 32, flipped the momentum back and opened the Inhibitor and Core minutes later.
coaching.whatWorked: The counter-build answered the heal-stacking threat directly: three anti-heal items went in against Riktor and Grux, the two enemy healers.

perPlayer.6bb7db38-126c-48c8-8779-490707ab9e7e: Greystone won the lane matchup against Drongo the whole game but paid for it everywhere else: a team-high 11 deaths and 56,561 damage taken. The build skipped all three meta-core items (Overlord, Rapture, Aegis Of Agawar) for a pure damage set into a comp running three physical damage sources — the matchup flag the engine raised directly.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Scarlett was the jungle's engine: 8 kills, 3 deaths, and a team-high 20,725 objective damage, closing out both Primal Fangtooth fights at 24.9 and 32.3. None of her three deaths were solo catches — all came inside team fights already in progress.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Shinbi's offlane matchup read even early and ours late; she killed Bayle three times.
perPlayer.a8651f53-1be6-4eb2-8e33-ad0f72163bfd: Steel did the frontline job the comp needed: a team-high 74,498 damage mitigated and 12 assists at 60% kill participation. The crack was getting caught alone three separate times, at 2.1, 10.7 and 17.7, by Drongo twice and Grux once — the pattern to fix, not the kill line.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Argus lost the lane and the box score both: Lt. Belica out-damaged him 54,469 to 23,322 in a matchup that read theirs all game. Still closed 6 kills to 3 deaths in the fights that mattered, and sitting out the 20-minute fight while pinned in a losing lane was the right restraint, not a missed rotation.

29.9.call: This teamfight went 3-4, but we still took an Inner Tower on the trade; Primal Fangtooth fell to them uncontested at minute 32 with the whole squad alive — a separate concession, not a consequence of this fight.. A costly fight to start — we had the 5v4 numbers edge at their Inner Tower and still lost it 3-4.

32.3.call: This 5-0 win punished the push right after they'd taken Primal Fangtooth uncontested at minute 32 — the fight that opened the Inhibitor and Core soon after.

ranking.grade: Scarlett: 8 kills, 3 deaths, team-high 20,725 objective damage, closed both decisive Fangtooth fights.
Steel: 74,498 mitigated and 12 assists, but caught alone three times: 2.1, 10.7, 17.7.
Argus: 6 kills, 3 deaths, but out-damaged 54,469-to-23,322 in a lane read theirs all game.
Greystone: 11 deaths, the team high, and no armor into a three-physical enemy comp.

6bb7db38-126c-48c8-8779-490707ab9e7e.build: Greystone skipped Overlord, Rapture and Aegis Of Agawar (armor, health and damage mitigation) for a full damage set (Sky Splitter, Tainted Rounds, Nightfall, Terminus) into a comp running three physical damage sources. The gap showed: team-high 56,561 damage taken and 11 deaths, the most on the roster.
6bb7db38-126c-48c8-8779-490707ab9e7e.eternal: The engine's modeled pick for Greystone is Krix, worth 18% effective health, fitting the stasis-and-soak win condition over a burst option like Demiurge.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.build: Scarlett has no tracked meta core in the jungle role to compare against, but the five-item set still put up a team-high 20,725 objective damage.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.eternal: The engine's modeled pick for Scarlett is also Krix for the same 18% effective-health boost, trading away Demiurge's burst for durability in extended jungle fights.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Shinbi ran the full winning core (Orb Of Enlightenment standing in for Orb Of Growth, plus Tainted Scepter and Oathkeeper) — on core, nothing to teach here.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.eternal: The engine's modeled pick for Shinbi is Krix for the effective-health boost, trading away Demiurge's fight-duration damage that suits the wolfpack ultimate.

a8651f53-1be6-4eb2-8e33-ad0f72163bfd.build: Steel skipped Xenia and Gaia Greaves (mana sustain and armor boots) for Tainted Guard, Tyranny and Frostguard instead, extra defense and anti-heal layered onto Dynamo. The mitigation still led the team at 74,498, so the swap wasn't the issue; the three solo catches were.
a8651f53-1be6-4eb2-8e33-ad0f72163bfd.eternal: The engine doesn't model support Eternals for Steel — no graded pick to compare here.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: Argus ran the full winning core (Azure Core, Entropy, Wraith Leggings) and added Oblivion Crown and Megacosm — on core, nothing to teach here.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.eternal: The engine's modeled pick for Argus is Demiurge, worth 14% more damage in extended fights, fitting the poke-and-zone kit over a dueling pick like Vesh.

focus.title: Separate the unproven rotation read from the trade that worked.
focus.evidence: At 14.8 we lost 0–2 with no objective conversion; the feed cannot place Shinbi. At 20 we lost 0–3 but took Fangtooth and their Outer Tower. Those are different reads, not two missed rotations.
focus.action: Review 14:48 before grading Shinbi’s rotation. Next game, call group or cross-map trade before the fight starts, then judge the decision by what the team converts.

threats: Chain-CC risk (6 hard-CC abilities, ~4.0s of lockdown): Bayle Kingslayer (knockback), Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s), Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s), Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Riktor, Grux. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 3 items of it.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
ourKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
ourKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

ourKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes → Line Tempo wolves → Circle Rhythm shield → All-Kill! wolfpack ult
ourKits.winCondition: stack Track and unleash All-Kill! in a grouped fight
ourKits.playAgainst: spread vs the wolfpack; she's squishy without her shield up

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

ourKits.combo: Dread Nova stun → Ether Crystal push/lift → Particle Shredder channel → Synaptic Obliterator beams
ourKits.winCondition: poke from max range and zone with the crystal
ourKits.playWith: a frontline to protect his stationary channel
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova; dive him during the immobile ult channel

enemyKits.combo: Skull Crusher gap-close → Dire Howl slow → Cursed Edge → Kingslayer knockback dash, Berserk at low HP
enemyKits.winCondition: engage, drop low into Berserk and out-brawl
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up while he commits the dive
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Berserk rewards low HP — burst him fully or disengage; anti-heal helps

enemyKits.combo: Riplash pull → Shock Therapy silence → Skewer suppress ult
enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and chain silence+suppress for a guaranteed kill
enemyKits.playWith: burst that deletes his pulled/suppressed target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect Riplash range — stay spaced; cleanse/QSS the suppress

enemyKits.combo: Old Rusty slow → Gag Grenade silence → Rad Rounds basics → Shrapnel Cannon armor shred
enemyKits.winCondition: kite back, stack Wastelander bleed and Rad Rounds, melt from range
enemyKits.playWith: peel and frontline so he can free-fire
enemyKits.playAgainst: low mobility — dive him or break LoS through his poke; he folds to hard engage

enemyKits.combo: Smash 'n Grab pull → Crush knockup → Warlord's Challenge stun → bleed-stacked basics
enemyKits.winCondition: land the pull→knockup chain to lock a target while bleed and AS shred them
enemyKits.passive: basics stack a bleed for sustained damage
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his knockup/stun window
enemyKits.playAgainst: telegraphed engage — bait Crush/Pull, then punish; kite his slow start

enemyKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
enemyKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down
